summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting the initial European shipment of LYMPHIR by its majority-owned subsidiary Citius Oncology. The filing also discloses a prior registered direct offering and concurrent private placement. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. The shipment is a routine operational milestone, not a special situation. The prior offering was previously reported, and no material terms are detailed here.
